synthesis.paragraph: A comparative evaluation evaluated three land use and land cover classification workflows in Odisha, India, to project changes through 2050 using the top-performing model. In Tehran, Iran, socio-housing and thermal imagery data across 116 districts were combined through Principal Component Analysis to map urban heat vulnerability via a Socio-Housing Disadvantage Index. Finally, a study analyzed municipal planning documents in Tuscany, Italy, using deductive content analysis to evaluate the integration of air quality and climate plans across local and regional governance levels.
